description:
Gravel SuperRoad Endurance: This LeChampion CF Disc WT Di2 Disc brake Gravel Endurance road bike can do it all. Endurance design means higher headtubes for a bit more upright and comfortable riding positions.

Comes with 32c Maxxis tires, capable of using up to 700x40c* to dominate gravel roads. Or use a narrow 700x28c for maximum speed on your commute. Laugh and float over rough roads, chipseal and revel in your Hydraulic Disc brakes through virtually all weather conditions.

Perfect for the sport to advanced level athlete wanting the performance of carbon frame, coupled with the precision and handling of a Carbon fork and dealing with a budget. This model has Shimano R7100 Forged Aluminum Compact cranks for hill-crushing performance at a lighter weight.
